{{Top|leg}}
A '''Scandoc decoding computer''' was a device employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to decode secure, encrypted [[Scandoc/Legends|Scandocs]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] recovered such a device during [[Operation Cobolt]]. It was passed on to the [[cryptology]] branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].
